account: UNEP’s MARS mitigation index lists eight Turkmenistan cases: two in Yelguyi in November 2024, Babarap in June 2025, Gugurtli field in July 2025, Balguyy in August 2025, two in Dauletabad in February 2026, and Lebap Province in March 2026. Each entry has a source identifier and a link to an individual case document. UNEP describes these as mitigations that its notification and monitoring system helped prompt and verify. UNEP states that MARS combines satellite observations, scientific review, and AI to identify emissions for government and company action. The available aggregate evidence does not isolate AI’s contribution from analysts, notifications, and physical repairs or quantify their combined benefit.

ai_role.statement: UNEP identifies AI as part of the satellite-analysis system that generates notifications and supports subsequent monitoring. Its public index names eight Turkmenistan mitigation cases. It does not isolate the AI contribution to each repair.

The available aggregate evidence does not isolate AI’s contribution from analysts, notifications, and physical repairs or quantify their combined benefit.
